Beyond Silence
Letter 01書信・01
What silence preserves, truth must one day release.
I can remain silent no longer.
我再也無法繼續沉默。
For longer than I can remember, I have persuaded myself that silence was the kinder course.
很長一段時間，我始終說服自己，沉默才是最溫柔的選擇。

Beyond Silence
Letter 02書信・02
There are affections time cannot persuade into absence.
It seemed the last kindness still within my power—to ask nothing of you, to expect nothing in return, and to leave undisturbed the life to which you have entrusted your faith, your duty, and your heart.
那似乎是我最後仍能給你的溫柔——不向你索求，不對你期待，也不驚擾那個你早已傾注信念、責任，以及真心的人生。
Yet there comes a moment when silence is no longer restraint.
然而，人終究會走到那樣的一刻。
← 上一頁2 / 20下一頁 →
Beyond Silence
Letter 03書信・03
A heart may remain quiet without becoming empty.
It becomes only another form of untruth.
沉默，不再是克制；它只是另一種不願承認真相的方式。
If these pages ought never to have been written, forgive them.
如果這封信本就不該存在，請原諒它。
← 上一頁3 / 20下一頁 →
Beyond Silence
Letter 04書信・04
Some hopes ask for nothing, and still endure.
They are not meant to alter your course, nor to loosen the bonds you have chosen to honour. I would never willingly become the cause of conflict within your heart.
它不是為了改變你的道路，也不是為了動搖那些你選擇守護的承諾。我從未希望自己，成為你內心任何掙扎的理由。
I wished only that one truth should no longer remain hidden.
我只是希望，有一件事，不再永遠停留於沉默之中。

Beyond Silence
Letter 05書信・05
What silence preserves, truth must one day release.
There has been one heart that has never learned to think of you with indifference.
始終有一顆心，從未真正學會用冷漠看待你。
Time, which the world so confidently praises for softening every attachment, has proved strangely powerless over mine.
世人總說，時間終會沖淡一切深刻的感情。
← 上一頁5 / 20下一頁 →
Beyond Silence
Letter 06書信・06
There are affections time cannot persuade into absence.
It has carried away many illusions, yet none of the quiet affection with which I have come to regard you.
但時間於我，卻始終沒有那樣的力量。它帶走了許多幻想，卻沒有帶走我對你的珍視。
There are sorrows that teach us to speak less, to hope less, and, at last, to feel less.
人生有些傷痛，會讓人愈來愈少開口，愈來愈少期待，也漸漸不敢再讓自己深深地感受。

Beyond Silence
Letter 07書信・07
A heart may remain quiet without becoming empty.
Sometimes I have wondered whether life has asked too much of your heart.
有時，我會想，命運是否曾向你的心索取了太多。
Whether disappointment has persuaded you that safety lies in silence, that expectation is a luxury too costly to keep,
是不是那些失望，讓你漸漸相信，把心收藏起來才是最安全的選擇；是不是那些遺憾，使你以為，期待終究是一件代價太高的事情；

Letter 08書信・08
Some hopes ask for nothing, and still endure.
and that tenderness is best hidden where neither joy nor grief may easily reach it.
是不是從某一天開始，你把所有的溫柔，都放進了一個連歡喜與悲傷都難以觸及的地方。
Yet I cannot persuade myself that such tenderness is ever truly lost.
可是，我始終無法相信，那份溫柔真的會因此消失。

Beyond Silence
Letter 09書信・09
What silence preserves, truth must one day release.
The dawn does not forget to arrive because the night has been long.
黑夜再漫長，也不會使晨光忘記升起。
Spring does not cease to exist because winter once claimed the garden.
冬天曾經覆蓋花園，也不能使春天忘記歸來。
← 上一頁9 / 20下一頁 →
Beyond Silence
Letter 10書信・10
There are affections time cannot persuade into absence.
Neither, I believe, does the heart forget how to hope merely because it has once been wounded.
我想，人心亦是如此。它或許受過傷，或許沉默，或許疲憊，卻不會因此忘記，希望原本就是它與生俱來的能力。
So it is not merely for myself that I continue to hope.
因此，我所懷抱的希望，並不只是為了我自己。

Beyond Silence
Letter 11書信・11
A heart may remain quiet without becoming empty.
I hope there will come a day when kindness no longer surprises you, when sincerity no longer seems improbable,
我希望，有一天，善意不再令你感到意外；真誠不再令你覺得難以相信；
and when your heart, without surrendering its wisdom, remembers that it was made not only to endure this world,
而你的心，在沒有失去智慧的同時，也仍然記得，它來到這個世界，不只是為了承受一切，

Letter 12書信・12
Some hopes ask for nothing, and still endure.
but also to delight in it.
它也可以因為喜悅，而再次跳動。
Whether such happiness should ever arrive by my hand, or by another's, matters less than the hope that it should arrive at all.
至於那份幸福，究竟會由我帶來，還是由另一個能夠光明正大陪伴你的人帶來，其實都沒有那麼重要。

Beyond Silence
Letter 13書信・13
What silence preserves, truth must one day release.
For I cannot believe that a heart such as yours was ever meant to belong only to disappointment.
我始終無法相信，一顆如你一般的心，終究只配與失望相伴。
If I have presumed too much, let these words return quietly to silence.
如果是我自作多情了，就讓這封信，也如沉默一般，慢慢歸於沉默。

Beyond Silence
Letter 14書信・14
There are affections time cannot persuade into absence.
If there is anything I should wish you to remember, let it be only this—that I have never wished for you anything that was not worthy of you.
但如果你願意記住一句話，我希望是這一句——我始終希望你所得到的愛與幸福，都真正配得上你。
Yet I would be less than honest if I pretended my own heart no longer hoped.
然而，如果我假裝自己的心，早已沒有一絲希望，那便不是誠實。

Letter 15書信・15
A heart may remain quiet without becoming empty.
Hope asks for very little.
希望，其實要求得很少。
Not certainty.
它不要肯定。

Beyond Silence
Letter 16書信・16
Some hopes ask for nothing, and still endure.
Not possession.
不要擁有。
Not even fulfilment.
甚至，不一定要求圓滿。
← 上一頁16 / 20下一頁 →
Beyond Silence
Letter 17書信・17
What silence preserves, truth must one day release.
Only that somewhere beyond all that neither of us can command, truth is not rendered meaningless merely because it arrived too late.
它只是希望，在那些我們都無法改變的命運之外，一份真心，不會因為來得太晚，而變得毫無意義。
Whatever tomorrow asks of either of us, I shall remain grateful that I have lived in a world where it was possible to know a soul such as yours.
無論明天會把我們帶向何方，我都會感謝命運。因為在我的生命裡，我曾有幸遇見像你這樣的一個靈魂。

Letter 18書信・18
There are affections time cannot persuade into absence.
And now, I have nothing left to withhold.
而如今，我已無從保留。
You pierce my soul.
你刺穿了我的靈魂。

Beyond Silence
如果妳真的走到了這裡，
那代表妳已經看完了所有我想說的話。

但還有一句話，
我想知道，妳是否還記得。
最後一次見面的時候，
我對妳說的最後一句話，是什麼？

原來，妳還記得。

原來，那一句話，
並沒有隨著那天的告別消失。

我不知道未來的妳，
會走向怎樣的人生。

也不知道最後陪在妳身邊的人，
會是誰。

但我希望，
那個人能理解妳的逞強，
也珍惜妳偶爾顯露的脆弱。

伊晶。

妳一直都是一個很好的人。
只是妳好像很少替自己這麼想。

妳值得被偏愛。

也值得被一個人，堅定地選擇。

希望有一天，
會有人像妳值得的那樣，
好好珍惜妳。

即使最後陪妳走下去的人不是我，
我也真心希望，
妳能一直幸福。

謝謝妳。

我愛妳。

—— 育弘
